# Extract zip codes from Lender column using regex pattern for 5-digit numbers
pattern = r'\b\d{5}\b'
match = re.findall(pattern, ' '.join(value))

if len(match) > 1:  # if multiple matches found, assume they are zip codes
    unique_zipcodes = list(set(match))  # remove duplicates and convert to set for faster comparison

    if len(unique_zipcodes) > 1:  # if more than one unique zip code is found, check for multiple loans
        return True  # return True if multiple loans were made to distinct companies sharing the same Zip code
else:
    return False  # return False if no multiple loans were made to distinct companies sharing the same Zip code
return value
